---
title: "Session 8 · Visualization"
subtitle: "Base graphics, ggplot2, and honest statistical communication"
---

## Learning goals

Choose a plot for a statistical question, construct and annotate base R plots,
read and build layered ggplot2 code, and export a figure at an explicit size.
Use the optional geom catalogue to find less familiar drawing methods.

## Materials

- [Lecture slides](slides.qmd) — includes discussion questions and the optional geom reference
- [Guided lab](lab.qmd) — six questions, with matching R Markdown and Quarto starters

## Lesson sequence

Build base R plots and ggplot2 layers, then compare repeated visits and subsets
with facets. Work through axis scales, log transformations, color and fill
mappings, and accessible encodings. Finish with a worked figure critique,
labels and themes, and PNG/PDF export.
